citations.assessment: The selected Bavli actually has Rava addressing Rabbi Natan bar Ammi. The Warsaw wording reverses the direction and makes Rava part of Natan’s name. Preserve the reported reading and flag the disagreement.

holds.raw: רבא בר נתן בר אמי אמר לרבא
holds.reason: The Rava-to-Natan bar Ammi direction in Kiddushin does not establish Heilprin’s form Rava bar Natan bar Ammi. The alternate form needs independent witness collation.

notes.text: The selected Kiddushin reverses the direction and names only Rabbi Natan bar Ammi. The entry’s reported wording is preserved as a variant.
